capabilities: Track Pathfinder 1e characters with derived stats like armor class, saves, and attack lines
Manage prepared, spontaneous, and hybrid spellcasting with a searchable 2,800+ spell database
Track equipment, inventory, and craft custom magic items with a forge tool
Apply situational combat modifiers and track expendable resource pools
Track familiars and animal companions linked to a master character
disambiguation: Not a character builder; it computes a character's stats but trusts you to build a legal character and does not enforce prerequisites.
extras: Full spell and maneuver text is not bundled; it ships as a separate reference-note pack you download into your vault and point the plugin at. Character data lives in the plugin's data.json and works with Obsidian Sync. The Elephant in the Room house-rule toggle is marked BETA.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in game-system tools, so playing a rules-heavy TTRPG means juggling external character sheets and doing the arithmetic by hand alongside your notes.

relations.evidence: If you also use the companion Carrel plugin, the References tab becomes a themed board of typed cards
If you use the community Style Settings plugin, Wayfinder exposes its two accent colors
Wayfinder supports Path of War, the third-party martial-maneuver system by Dreamscarred Press

summary: A Pathfinder 1e character sheet living in Obsidian's right sidebar that computes stats, spells, combat, and equipment, tuned for iPad play at the table.
